pages: Vendor supply agreement between Acme and Borealis. Late delivery penalty: one percent of the order value per week of delay, capped at ten percent.
Termination: either party may terminate with ninety days written notice.
Mutual confidentiality agreement. Confidential information must not be disclosed for five years after termination.
Governing law: the courts of Zurich have exclusive jurisdiction.
Remote work policy. Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
Equipment: laptops are provided by the company and must be returned on leaving.
Password policy. Passwords must have at least fourteen characters and be rotated every one hundred eighty days.
Multi factor authentication is required for all administrative access.
Loan facility agreement. The interest rate is the reference rate plus two point five percent. Repayment in twelve quarterly instalments.
Events of default include missed payments and breach of financial covenants.
Cyber insurance policy covers ransomware recovery costs up to five million.
Exclusions: war, nuclear events and unpatched known vulnerabilities.
Office lease agreement for floor four. Monthly rent is forty thousand, payable in advance.
The tenant may sublet the office only with written landlord consent.
Privileged memo on the arbitration strategy for the Orion dispute. The settlement ceiling is confidential and must not be shared.
Procurement policy requires three competitive quotes for purchases above fifty thousand.
Sole source purchases need director approval and written justification.
Data retention schedule. Customer records are kept for seven years after account closure.
Backups are deleted after thirty five days.
